00047 TSpawnUGenInternal::TSpawnUGenInternal(const int numChannels, UGen const& trig, const int maxRepeats) throw()
00048 : SpawnBaseUGenInternal(NumInputs, numChannels, maxRepeats),
00049   lastTrig(0.f)
00050 {
00051   inputs[Trig] = trig;  // should have already been ensured to be a single channel
00052 }
00053 
00054 void TSpawnUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00055 {
00056   if(shouldStopAllEvents() == true) initEvents();
00057   
00058   if(reachedMaxRepeats() == true)
00059   {
00060     SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00061   }
00062   else
00063   {
00064     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00065     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;  
00066     int startSample = 0;
00067     int numSamples = 0;
00068     
00069     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00070     
00071     float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00072     
00073     while(numSamplesToProcess)
00074     {
00075       float currentTrig = *trigSamples++;
00076             
00077       if(lastTrig <= 0.f && currentTrig > 0.f)
00078       {
00079         if(numSamples > 0)
00080         {
00081           // render samples from startSample to startSample+numSample         
00082           for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00083           {
00084             bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData() + startSample;
00085           }
00086           
00087           mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamples, blockID + startSample, -1);
00088           mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamples, numChannels);
00089           mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID + startSample, -1);
00090         }
00091         
00092         startSample += numSamples;
00093         numSamples = 1;
00094         
00095         // add the new voice
00096         UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++);
00097         events.add(newVoice);
00098       }
00099       else
00100       {
00101         ++numSamples;
00102       }
00103       
00104       lastTrig = currentTrig; 
00105       --numSamplesToProcess;
00106     }
00107         
00108     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00109     {
00110       bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData() + startSample;
00111     }
00112     
00113     mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamples, blockID + startSample, -1);
00114     mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamples, numChannels);
00115     mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID + startSample, -1);
00116     
00117     events.removeNulls();
00118   }
00119 }

00122 bool TSpawnUGenInternal::trigger(void* extraArgs) throw()
00123 {
00124   if(reachedMaxRepeats() == false)
00125   {
00126     UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++, extraArgs);
00127     events.add(newVoice);
00128   }
00129   
00130   return true;
00131 }
